name: generate_image
description: 🎨 Generate AI images with Gemini, OpenAI, or xAI. Create pictures, artwork, infographics, visualizations. Use when user says 'generate an image', 'create a picture', 'make artwork', 'draw', 'visualize'. PROVIDERS: Gemini (default) has Google Search grounding; OpenAI has best text rendering; xAI is fast and cheap. Example: 'Create an infographic of today's weather' with use_grounding=true (Gemini). Images save to stash for email, print, canvas, PDF.

prompt.description: Detailed description of the image. Be specific about subject, colors, mood, composition. Example: 'A cozy coffee shop with warm lighting, plants, and a cat on a chair'

provider.description: Image provider: 'gemini' (default, grounding for real-time data), 'openai' (gpt-image-1, best text), 'xai' (grok-imagine, fast & cheap). Uses IMAGE_TOOL_PROVIDER from config if not specified.

aspect_ratio.description: Image shape: 'square' (1:1), 'landscape' (16:9), 'portrait' (9:16), 'wide' (21:9/cinematic), or exact ratios. OpenAI maps to closest size.

image_size.description: Resolution/Quality: '1K' (fast/low), '2K' (default/medium), '4K' (best/high). For OpenAI, maps to quality setting.

use_grounding.description: 🌐 GEMINI ONLY: Enable Google Search grounding for REAL-TIME data. Use for: weather infographics, stock charts, current events, sports scores. Gemini searches web first, then generates accurate imagery.

style.description: Art style: photorealistic, anime, watercolor, oil painting, sketch, digital art, 3D render, pixel art, comic book, impressionist, minimalist, cyberpunk, fantasy, infographic

negative_prompt.description: Things to avoid: 'blurry, low quality, text, watermark, distorted'

context_data.description: GEMINI ONLY: Data from other Jarvis tools to incorporate. Example: weather data, crypto prices. Chain tools: get data first, pass here.

transparent.description: OPENAI ONLY: Enable transparent background. Works with png/webp output. Great for logos, sprites, overlays.

output_format.description: OPENAI ONLY: Output format. 'png' (default, lossless), 'jpeg' (faster, smaller), 'webp' (modern, good compression). Transparent requires png/webp.

n.description: XAI ONLY: Number of images to generate (1-10). Only first image is saved to stash; all returned in response.

save.description: Save to stash for use with email/print/canvas/PDF (default: true)
